how_picked: picked on 2021-11..2024-12 (plateau, 1.5+ a week: nothing at 2+ a week qualified), 2025 / 2026 untouched
rules: Session: NY (leg confirmed 09:30-11:30 ET, entries until 12:00).
Opening structure: the session's first 15 minutes' range.
Directional leg: the session's first 5m close beyond it, leg >= 3 x the 5m ATR(14) from the session's low (high); only the first leg of the session counts.
Filters: close on the trend side of the 18:00 session VWAP
Entry zone: the first pullback into the leg's most recent 5m fair value gap within 60 minutes of the leg; below the leg origin first = no trade.
Trigger (within 30 minutes of the touch): a 5m CISD back in the trend (close beyond the open of the candle run into the pullback extreme); entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the pullback's protected low (high) (6-80 pts, else no trade).
Time exit: 15:55 ET. One trade a session.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); $1.90 a micro, 1 tick slippage on market fills.
costs: $1.90 a micro round trip + 1 tick on market entries, stop and time exits
data: TradingView CME NQ1! 5m (data/NQ_5m.csv), 1m for the 2026 trade path (data/NQ_1m.csv)
